Job.Description:
• Develop and implement comprehensive risk management frameworks and strategies to identify, assess, and mitigate potential threats across the organization.
  • Conduct in-depth risk assessments and analyses for new projects, systems, and business processes, providing actionable recommendations for risk reduction.
  • Design and oversee the execution of risk control measures, including policies, procedures, and technological solutions, to safeguard company assets and operations.
  • Monitor and analyze key risk indicators (KRIs) and performance metrics to ensure the effectiveness of risk management programs and identify emerging risks.

Other.Keywords: Risk Control Specialist,Risk Assessment,Compliance,Threat Modeling,Information Security,Lead Risk Engineer,Senior Risk Analyst,Quantitative Risk Manager

DesiredCandidate.Profile:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Finance, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Professional certifications such as CRISC, CISM, CISSP, FRM, or PRM are highly desirable.
  • Minimum of 5-7 years of progressive experience in risk engineering, risk management, or a related analytical role within the technology or financial services industry.
  • Proven expertise in developing and implementing enterprise-wide risk management frameworks and methodologies.
